name: Nokia C21

Body.Other: Rear-mounted fingerprint scanner, accelerometer, proximity sensor

Platform.Chipset: Unisoc SC9863A (28 nm), Octa-core (4×1.6 GHz Cortex-A55 & 4×1.2 GHz Cortex-A55)

Memory.RAM: C21: 2/3 GB, C21 Plus: 2/3/4 GB, LPDDR4X

Cameras.Rear camera: C21: 8 MP, LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 720p@30fps, C21 Plus: 13 MP (wide), AF + 2 MP, f/2.4 (depth), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps

Battery.Battery: Li-Ion, C21: removable, 3000 mAh, C21 Plus: non-removable, 4000 or 5050 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, Bluetooth 4.2 (A2DP), FM radio, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n (hotspot), GPS, A-GPS
